method: Read existing evidence; recomputed all inventory statistics from all retained raw values, reconstructed the ten deterministic fixtures and full post-action state hashes, checked frame-summary arithmetic and driver timing semantics. No new performance sample, suite or browser was run.

inventory.orderVerified: baseline then after for each repeat 1–12; fixed alternating order, not randomized/counterbalanced
inventory.quantileRule: sorted[Math.floor((n-1)*p)]; for n=12 the reported p50 is the sixth sorted sample, not the arithmetic average of the middle two. p95 and p99 both select the eleventh sample.
inventory.HTMLProvenance: The driver reads all 60 card outerHTML trees after the second-rAF end timestamp and asserts their digest against one reference. The report retains matching hashes and byte sizes, not the raw HTML strings.

mainAndCoverage.mainMatrix: 2 variants × 2 logical sizes × 2 scenes × 2 effect modes × 1 repeat
mainAndCoverage.coverageMatrix: 2 variants × rarities 0–6 at 1920/full, one repeat each; not pooled with the main matrix

expectedFullEffectStageCoverage.lowModeNote: Eight main low-effects windows are exempt from full-stage observation by design; their true flag is not proof a full effect stage was sampled.

fixtureAndSourceOracles.method: Reconstructed only the inspected deterministic fixture declarations; no timing collection or browser execution. Independently recomputed full expected post-action hashes with both authoritative engines.

timingAndRenderer.renderer: ANGLE Vulkan SwiftShader (Subzero), same software renderer for both variants
timingAndRenderer.inventoryBoundary: Trusted native click capture performance.now() through second requestAnimationFrame callback; fixture loading, transport, DOM hashing and state assertions are outside the measured elapsed value.
timingAndRenderer.frameBoundary: Trusted primary-action capture through first rAF callback at or after 4200 ms. Initial click-to-first-callback latency is included. A long interval may overshoot the requested duration and is retained.
timingAndRenderer.thirtySecondDeadline: A 30-second Node Promise.race bounds measuredResult after the awaited native click resolves. It is not a 4200 ms cap or an absolute 30-second deadline starting at capture. Click/navigation waits separately allow up to 60 seconds. No timed-out replacement sample exists.
timingAndRenderer.longTasks: Observer entries are included when they overlap the recorded window, with overlap clipped to window boundaries. Large rAF gaps are not automatically JavaScript long tasks.
timingAndRenderer.limitations: Only one repeat per main cell, fixed baseline-first ordering, software rendering, two unobserved expected full-effect stages, and no retained raw frame intervals preclude an overall speedup or smoothness conclusion.

completedNativeGateAudit.method: Fresh delegated source_manifest recount from original decompressed TAP, not adoption of the prior independent summary. No tests rerun.
completedNativeGateAudit.HTTPAndSyntaxBasis: Retained completed evidence inspected; not re-executed. HTTP reports 62 resources and release 5.19.0.

recommendation.releaseCharacterization: Present this as a verified inventory-discovery and UI correctness improvement with mixed software-rendered timing results. Retain MEASURED_WITH_LIMITATIONS. Do not advertise an overall performance gain, no-regression performance pass or physical 4K smoothness.
regressionsToStateFirst: Inventory floor-rank p50 rises 137.1 → 224.0 ms (+86.9 ms, +63.38%).
3840×2160 eternal-open/full maximum rises 2950.8 → 10096.0 ms (+7145.2 ms, about 3.42×); its expected loot-7 stage was not sampled.
1920/full boss and eternal-open maxima also worsen (347.0 → 2375.1 ms and 912.5 → 1525.4 ms).
improvementsToStateWithScope: Inventory p95/p99 falls 471.2 → 447.1 ms and maximum falls 1744.9 → 561.5 ms within the 12 samples per variant.
Worst recorded interval across the whole main/coverage report falls 11546.1 → 10096.0 ms, but that pooled maximum must not conceal cell regressions.
recommendation.interpretation: Correctness and evidence integrity pass; the collected performance evidence is mixed and cannot establish a causal speed improvement. A 16.7 ms callback median does not mean smooth 60 FPS when retained individual gaps exceed ten seconds.
